environment.description: Laravel 10.x application deployed on Kubernetes (EKS 1.28) with MySQL 8.0 backend. Pod runs as root in a privileged container with hostPath volume mount at /var/run/mysqld. No network policies applied. The application container has direct TCP access to the MySQL instance on port 3306. Database user has GRANT ALL on the application schema. No WAF or SQL filtering middleware in the ingress path. PodSecurityPolicy is not enforced (PSP admission controller disabled in cluster).
